title: Design System: Pomi B. Brow Studio

stack.cms: Sanity; Studio served at /admin, schema in cms/
stack.images: astro:assets (webp, quality 80, responsive widths) via src/components/Photo.astro
stack.fonts: @fontsource-variable/newsreader (index + opsz axis), @fontsource-variable/geist, self-hosted; Geist Mono is a stack only, not loaded
stack.logo: src/assets/brand/logo-black.svg, logo-white.svg (client brush-script wordmark, inlined via ?raw)

display.purpose: Hero h1 only; max-width 12ch, text-wrap balance, Newsreader opsz 72.

numeral.purpose: The Yelp review count as one object beside a sans title; one per page.

headline.purpose: Every section h2, inside a .section-head capped at 44rem. No kicker above it.

quote.purpose: Short review quotes (under 220 characters) in Newsreader opsz 24; longer quotes fall back to Body.

title.purpose: h3s in Geist 500: service names, timeline step titles, the review-count sentence.

lede.purpose: The single deck under each h2, max 40ch, Ink Muted.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, FAQ answers, inputs. Measure 62ch. Secondary paragraphs drop to Ink Muted.

small.purpose: Buttons, nav links, text links, price rows, footer. Tabular numerals for phone numbers and prices.

caption.purpose: Photo captions, form labels, hero meta line, price footnote. Sentence case; service name in Ink 500.

label.purpose: Tag text only. The only uppercase on the site.

meta.purpose: Optional price in a caption, in the monospace stack (system mono; Geist Mono is not loaded).

shadows.name: shadow-hover
shadows.purpose: The only shadow. Cards and Instagram tiles on hover over 200ms; absent at rest. Never on buttons.

shadows.name: input-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus spread on inputs, with the border turned to Ink.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Reveal, button active, arrow nudge, call-bar slide.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Color and underline transitions on links, nav, inputs.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Button fill, card hover shadow, arrow nudge, call-bar slide.

motion.name: dur-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-entry reveal: opacity 0 to 1, translateY(12px) to none; siblings stagger by calc(var(--i) * 80ms); IntersectionObserver threshold 0.05, rootMargin 0 0 -8% 0; inert under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: bento-2col
breakpoints.purpose: Bento to two columns; form name/phone row to two columns.

breakpoints.name: footer-3col
breakpoints.purpose: Footer to 1.6fr 1fr 1fr; review numeral beside its text.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Primary switch: nav and header Call button appear, mobile call bar hides, two-column sections and 3-col bento engage.

imagery.grain: ::after, opacity 0.04, mix-blend-mode multiply, warm fractal-noise SVG tiled at 160px
imagery.frame: 1px solid var(--border), border-radius 12px, background var(--surface), object-fit cover
imagery.note: Grade is deliberately mild: pigment color is the evidence and must not be misrepresented. Nothing is drawn over a photograph.

icons.stroke: 2px, round caps and joins, currentColor, viewBox 0 0 24 24

components.css: .ds-photo-fig { margin: 0; max-width: 20rem; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Geist Variable', 'Geist Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-photo { position: relative; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: var(--surface, #f9f9f8); border: 1px solid var(--border, #eaeaea); border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); } .ds-photo img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; filter: saturate(0.88) contrast(1.02); } .ds-photo::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.04; mix-blend-mode: multiply; background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='160' height='160'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 0.35 0 0 0 0 0.25 0 0 0 0 0.15 0 0 0 1 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>"); background-size: 160px 160px; } .ds-caption { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem; padding-top: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink-muted, #787774); } .ds-caption__service { color: var(--ink, #111111); font-weight: 500; } .ds-caption__price { margin-left: auto; font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; }

narrative.overview:
This site is a document, not a brochure. Everything on the page that is not a photograph or a sentence is a one-pixel #EAEAEA line. The world follows the installed minimalist-ui protocol (premium utilitarian minimalism): a pure white canvas, a warm off-black type family, an editorial serif for the few lines that carry the argument, and a clean sans for everything else. Color is scarce and only ever means something. The persuasion is carried by real healed photography with quiet sentence-case captions, a healing timeline, and third-party reviews; the interface stays out of their way.

Density is low and rhythm is macro-first. Sections breathe at six to eight rem, sit on a single hairline, and hold one heading, one lede, and one body of proof each. Nothing lifts, glows, or slides except a scroll-entry reveal that fades content twelve pixels upward as it arrives. The client's brush-script wordmark is the only ornament and the only thing on the page that is not set in Newsreader or Geist.

This world replaced the earlier "Brow Map" system on 2026-09-07 after the client rejected it. Confirmed rejections carried from that decision: no skin-tone or brown colored section fields, no mapping lines or diagrams drawn over photographs, no pill-shaped buttons, no drop shadows, no script or display faces beyond the wordmark, no soft-focus face hero.
keyCharacteristics: White canvas only; surfaces differ by a hairline, never by a colored slab.
One border color (#EAEAEA) at one weight (1px) does all structural work: section rules, card edges, photo frames, dividers, the timeline axis.
Newsreader at optical size 72 for h1, h2, and the review numeral; Geist for body and every control.
Four muted pastels appear only inside tags and form status, always with a semantic meaning.
Every photograph is framed at 12px with a 1px border, receives the same mild grade and 4% warm grain, and carries a caption.
Buttons are solid #111111, 6px radius, no shadow. Tags are the only pill shape.
Motion is one gesture: the scroll-entry reveal. Nothing else animates beyond 200ms color and arrow-nudge transitions.

rules.name: The One Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every border, rule, divider, and frame is 1px solid #EAEAEA. There is no second border color and no second weight; the timeline dot's outline (#787774) is the sole exception because it must read at 9px.

rules.name: The Tag-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Pastel fills appear only in tags (24px tall pills) and the form status line. Never as a section field, card fill, icon background, heading color, or button.

rules.name: The White Field Rule
rules.body: Sections have no background color. Adjacent sections are separated by one hairline and six to eight rem of white, nothing else.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Newsreader is used for h1, h2, the numeral, and short quotes; everything else is Geist. No third face except the client's wordmark SVG.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading. Section heads are h2 then lede, full stop. Tags label cards and timeline steps, never headings.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Uppercase exists only inside tags. Captions, labels, nav, and buttons are sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing carries a shadow at rest. Buttons never carry one at all. The only shadow is the 4% hover lift on cards and tiles.

rules.name: The Fixed-Light Rule
rules.body: It is never painted on a scrolling section.

dos: Do keep the canvas white and separate sections with one full-width 1px solid #EAEAEA rule and clamp(6rem, 4rem + 5vw, 8rem) of padding.
Do use 1px solid #EAEAEA for every border, frame, divider, and axis at exactly one weight.
Do set h1 and h2 in Newsreader at opsz 72, weight 400, -0.025em, line-height 1.1, and everything else in Geist at line-height 1.6.
Do make every button #111111 with white text, 6px radius, 2.875rem tall, hover #333333, active scale(0.98), and no shadow.
Do reserve the four pastels for tags and form status, each with a fixed meaning (yellow Eyebrows / Week 6, blue Eyes, red Lips, green Hair; green success, red error).
Do frame every photograph at 12px with a hairline, apply saturate(0.88) contrast(1.02) and the 4% warm grain, and caption it in sentence case.
Do hold content to the 64rem column and section heads to 44rem; ledes to 40ch, body to 62ch.
Do enter content with the scroll-entry reveal (12px, 600ms, 80ms stagger) and nothing else.
Do draw icons from the hand-drawn 2px-stroke set in currentColor, sized 1rem to 1.15rem.
Do show a single Call control in the header and the mobile bar while booking is by phone.
donts: Don't give any section, hero, or card a colored or tinted background; Bone and Surface are for tag fills and image placeholders only.
Don't put a kicker, eyebrow, or tag above a heading; h2 then lede is the whole section head.
Don't use a pill radius on anything except a tag; buttons and cards top out at 6px and 12px.
Don't add a shadow at rest anywhere, or exceed 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04) on hover.
Don't draw lines, maps, or overlays on a photograph, or push the grade past the mild uniform grade.
Don't introduce a third typeface, uppercase anything outside a tag, or use pure #000000 for text.
Don't add a dark mode or a Book control until a booking target exists; neither is built.
